cards.back:
Something that costs less than its usual price.
Bahasa Indonesia: barang yang harganya murah
Example: The shoes were a bargain because they were half price.
cards.say: bargain. Something that costs less than its usual price. The shoes were a bargain because they were half price.

cards.back:
A paper that shows what you paid for.
Bahasa Indonesia: struk
Example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the toy.
cards.say: receipt. A paper that shows what you paid for. Keep the receipt in case you need to return the toy.

cards.back:
An amount taken off the usual price.
Bahasa Indonesia: diskon
Example: The shop gave a discount on all school bags this week.
cards.say: discount. An amount taken off the usual price. The shop gave a discount on all school bags this week.

cards.back:
A person who buys things from a shop.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelanggan
Example: The friendly cashier helped every customer in the long queue.
cards.say: customer. A person who buys things from a shop. The friendly cashier helped every customer in the long queue.

cards.back:
A person who takes the money in a shop.
Bahasa Indonesia: kasir
Example: The cashier gave me my change and a small bag.
cards.say: cashier. A person who takes the money in a shop. The cashier gave me my change and a small bag.

cards.back:
A plan for how much money you can spend.
Bahasa Indonesia: anggaran
Example: Dad set a budget so we would not spend too much.
cards.say: budget. A plan for how much money you can spend. Dad set a budget so we would not spend too much.

cards.back:
To have enough money to buy something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mampu membeli
Example: We cannot afford a new bike until we save more.
cards.say: afford. To have enough money to buy something. We cannot afford a new bike until we save more.

cards.back:
Costing a lot of money.
Bahasa Indonesia: mahal
Example: The gold watch was too expensive for a child to buy.
cards.say: expensive. Costing a lot of money. The gold watch was too expensive for a child to buy.

cards.back:
Costing little money.
Bahasa Indonesia: murah
Example: Bananas are cheap at the village market this morning.
cards.say: cheap. Costing little money. Bananas are cheap at the village market this morning.

cards.back:
Money that a shop gives back to you.
Bahasa Indonesia: pengembalian uang
Example: The shop gave me a refund because the toy was broken.
cards.say: refund. Money that a shop gives back to you. The shop gave me a refund because the toy was broken.

cards.back:
To buy something, or the thing that you buy.
Bahasa Indonesia: pembelian
Example: Her best purchase was a large notebook with a bright cover.
cards.say: purchase. To buy something, or the thing that you buy. Her best purchase was a large notebook with a bright cover.

cards.back:
The amount of money you must pay for something.
Bahasa Indonesia: harga
Example: The price of the book is written on the back.
cards.say: price. The amount of money you must pay for something. The price of the book is written on the back.

cards.back:
The money you earn after paying all your costs.
Bahasa Indonesia: keuntungan
Example: The stall made a profit by selling lemonade on a hot day.
cards.say: profit. The money you earn after paying all your costs. The stall made a profit by selling lemonade on a hot day.

cards.back:
Money you lose when you spend more than you earn.
Bahasa Indonesia: kerugian
Example: The shop made a loss when its goods were damaged by rain.
cards.say: loss. Money you lose when you spend more than you earn. The shop made a loss when its goods were damaged by rain.

cards.back:
Money that you keep and do not spend.
Bahasa Indonesia: tabungan
Example: She put her savings in a tin to buy a new bicycle.
cards.say: savings. Money that you keep and do not spend. She put her savings in a tin to buy a new bicycle.

cards.back:
Money paid to a person for the work they do.
Bahasa Indonesia: upah
Example: The baker received her wage at the end of each week.
cards.say: wage. Money paid to a person for the work they do. The baker received her wage at the end of each week.

cards.back:
The money given back when you pay more than the price.
Bahasa Indonesia: uang kembalian
Example: I gave the seller a note and received coins as change.
cards.say: change. The money given back when you pay more than the price. I gave the seller a note and received coins as change.

cards.back:
A place where people buy and sell goods, often outdoors.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasar
Example: We buy fresh fish and fruit at the market every Sunday.
cards.say: market. A place where people buy and sell goods, often outdoors. We buy fresh fish and fruit at the market every Sunday.

cards.back:
A large shop that sells food and many other things.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasar swalayan
Example: Mum pushed the trolley down the aisles of the supermarket.
cards.say: supermarket. A large shop that sells food and many other things. Mum pushed the trolley down the aisles of the supermarket.

cards.back:
A name that a company gives to its products.
Bahasa Indonesia: merek
Example: She chose a well known brand of running shoes.
cards.say: brand. A name that a company gives to its products. She chose a well known brand of running shoes.

cards.back:
To ask for goods or food to be brought to you.
Bahasa Indonesia: memesan
Example: We will order a pizza online for the party.
cards.say: order. To ask for goods or food to be brought to you. We will order a pizza online for the party.

cards.back:
The act of bringing goods to someone's home.
Bahasa Indonesia: pengiriman
Example: The delivery of our new sofa arrived on Tuesday morning.
cards.say: delivery. The act of bringing goods to someone's home. The delivery of our new sofa arrived on Tuesday morning.
